name: pi-verify-gate
description: Local verification status for the Pi coding agent: run the project's own check (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun script, cargo test, go test, pytest, make check) only when the working tree actually changed, with a zero-token footer badge, an on-demand verify_status tool
